name: tock-mcp
description: Tock (exploretock.com) restaurant discovery for Claude — list cities, search a metro, get venue details and their bookable experiences, prices, and open dates/times. Relays every request through the ContextMint Bridge browser extension (github.com/nullnet-app/contextmint-bridge) running in your signed-in exploretock.com tab, so there's no cookie paste or bot-wall dance.

tock_ws_port.title: Bridge WebSocket port (advanced)
tock_ws_port.description: Optional. Concentrator port for the fetchproxy browser bridge (defaults to the fleet-shared 37149). On one machine every MCP shares the concentrator, so move it for ALL of them or not at all. Leave blank for the default.

fetchproxy_ws_host.title: Bridge bind interface (hosted only)
fetchproxy_ws_host.description: Optional. Bind interface, a literal IP only (anything else is ignored); default 127.0.0.1. Keep on loopback — it exists for ONE topology: a hosted child in its own network namespace. Leave blank for the default.

fetchproxy_identity_dir.title: Bridge identity directory (hosted only)
fetchproxy_identity_dir.description: Optional. Where to store the long-term identity keypair, an absolute path only (anything else is ignored); default ~/.fetchproxy/identity/. Exists for a host that runs a separate child per caller. Leave blank for the default.

tools.name: tock_list_metros
tools.description: List Tock cities/metros (name, slug, business count), optionally filtered.

tools.name: tock_search_restaurants
tools.description: List / search restaurants in a Tock metro by slug, with an optional text query.

tools.name: tock_get_restaurant
tools.description: Get full details for a Tock venue by slug: cuisine, price, location, and its bookable experiences.

tools.name: tock_get_availability
tools.description: Get a venue's bookable calendar: experiences, prices, party sizes, and open dates/times.

tools.name: tock_list_reservations
tools.description: List the signed-in user's Tock reservations (upcoming / past / canceled) via the GraphQL API (requires a signed-in exploretock.com tab).

tools.name: tock_get_profile
tools.description: Get the signed-in user's Tock account identity — name, email (requires a signed-in exploretock.com tab).

tools.name: tock_verify_reservation
tools.description: Verify a Tock booking actually landed: re-query the account's upcoming, canceled and past reservations and return confirmed / cancelled / not_found / ambiguous (requires a signed-in exploretock.com tab).

tools.name: tock_healthcheck
tools.description: Check each hop of the ContextMint Bridge connection to exploretock.com — call it when a tool fails to see which hop broke.
